# git-trim

git-trim automatically trims local tracking branches whose upstream branches are merged or removed.

Installation

- Download a prebuilt binary from the Releases page and place it in a directory on your PATH.

Usage

- Run `git trim` in a repository to detect and optionally delete local branches that are merged or whose upstreams are gone.
- Use `git trim --dry-run` to see what would be deleted without making changes.
- For full command-line options and detailed usage, see the included man page: `docs/git-trim.man`.

Screenshots and Examples

- A screencast and example images may be available in the repository (e.g. `screencast.png`, `images/`).

License

This project is provided under the terms of the project's LICENSE file.

       git-trim [FLAGS] [OPTIONS]

              Prints help information

              Do not update remotes [config: trim.update]

       --no-confirm
              Do not ask confirm [config: trim.confirm]

       --no-detach
              Do not detach when HEAD is about to be deleted [config: trim.detach]

              Do not delete branches, show what branches will be deleted

{"command":"cat > .lab/merges.py <<'PY'
from scenarios import *
repo,seed,bare=setup('merges')
write(repo,'base','initial\n');git(repo,'push','-q')
# Squashed multi-commit branch.
git(repo,'checkout','-qb','squashed');write(repo,'one','first\n');write(repo,'two','second\n');git(repo,'push','-qu','origin','squashed')
git(repo,'checkout','-q','main');git(repo,'merge','--squash','squashed');git(repo,'commit','-qm','Squash')
# Cherry-picked topic, cherry-pick following an unrelated main commit.
git(repo,'checkout','-qb','cherry');write(repo,'cherry','picked\n');git(repo,'push','-qu','origin','cherry')
git(repo,'checkout','-q','main');write(repo,'other','unrelated\n');git(repo,'cherry-pick','cherry')
# Empty branch commit: should have no novel content.
git(repo,'checkout','-qb','empty');git(repo,'commit','-qm','Empty','--allow-empty');git(repo,'push','-qu','origin','empty')
git(repo,'checkout','-q','main')
# Patch independently present but main file is now changed.
git(repo,'checkout','-qb','overwritten');write(repo,'modified','original patch\n');git(repo,'push','-qu','origin','overwritten')
git(repo,'checkout','-q','main');write(repo,'other2','other patch\n');git(repo,'cherry-pick','overwritten');write(repo,'modified','subsequent modification\n')
# Partial cherry-pick: first but not second commit is included.
git(repo,'checkout','-qb','partial');write(repo,'partial1','included\n');first=git(repo,'rev-parse','HEAD');write(repo,'partial2','not included\n');git(repo,'push','-qu','origin','partial')
git(repo,'checkout','-q','main');git(repo,'cherry-pick',first);git(repo,'push','-q')
run(repo,'--no-update','--dry-run')
ENV['RUST_LOG']='trace'
p=subprocess.run([EXE,'--no-update','--dry-run'],cwd=repo,env=ENV,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
open(ROOT+'/merges-log.txt','wb').write(p.stderr)
PY
python3 .lab/merges.py; grep -E 'merge_tracker|subprocess|message:|Error:' .lab/merges-log.txt | head -n 100"}

from probe import *
import pty,select,time,termios

def tty(repo,args,key=b'n\n'):
 pid,fd=pty.fork()
 if pid==0:
  os.chdir(repo);os.execve(EXE,[EXE,*args],dict(ENV,TERM='xterm-256color'))
 out=b'';sent=False;start=time.monotonic()
 while time.monotonic()-start<5:
  r,_,_=select.select([fd],[],[],.15)
  if r:
   try:b=os.read(fd,65536)
   except OSError:break
   if not b:break
   out+=b
  if not sent and time.monotonic()-start>1:
   os.write(fd,key);sent=True
 try:os.kill(pid,0);os.kill(pid,15)
 except ProcessLookupError:pass
 _,status=os.waitpid(pid,0)
 os.close(fd)
 print('ARGS',args,'KEY',repr(key),'STATUS',status,'OUT',repr(out.decode()),flush=True)
if __name__=='__main__':

"""Self-contained regression tests.  Only the implementation and Git are used."""
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import tempfile
import unittest

EXE = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / 'executable'


class TrimTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.temp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='trim-test-')
        self.root = Path(self.temp.name)
        self.remote = self.root / 'remote.git'
        self.repo = self.root / 'work'
        self.env = dict(os.environ,
                        GIT_AUTHOR_NAME='Test User', GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL='test@example.com',
                        GIT_COMMITTER_NAME='Test User', GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL='test@example.com',
                        GIT_AUTHOR_DATE='2024-01-01T00:00:00Z', GIT_COMMITTER_DATE='2024-01-01T00:00:00Z',
                        GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL='/dev/null', GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM='1',
                        GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT='0', NO_COLOR='1')
        for key in ('GIT_DIR', 'GIT_WORK_TREE', 'GIT_INDEX_FILE', 'RUST_LOG', 'CLICOLOR_FORCE'):
            self.env.pop(key, None)
        self.git('init', '--bare', '-q', '-b', 'main', str(self.remote), cwd=self.root)
        self.git('clone', '-q', str(self.remote), str(self.repo), cwd=self.root)
        self.git('commit', '-qm', 'Initial', '--allow-empty')
        self.git('push', '-qu', 'origin', 'main')
        self.git('remote', 'set-head', 'origin', 'main')

    def tearDown(self):
        self.temp.cleanup()

    def git(self, *args, cwd=None):
        p = subprocess.run(['git', *args], cwd=cwd or self.repo, env=self.env,
                           stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, check=True)
        return p.stdout.decode().strip()

    def trim(self, *args):
        return subprocess.run([str(EXE), *args], cwd=self.repo, env=self.env, input='',
                              text=True, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)

    def feature(self, name='feature'):
        self.git('branch', name)
        self.git('push', '-qu', 'origin', name)

    def commit_file(self, name, data):
        (self.repo / name).write_text(data)
        self.git('add', name)
        self.git('commit', '-qm', data.strip())

    def refs(self, cwd=None):
        return self.git('for-each-ref', '--format=%(refname) %(objectname)', cwd=cwd)

    def test_help_version_and_argument_errors(self):
        self.assertEqual(self.trim('--version').stdout, 'git-trim 0.4.4\n')
        self.assertIn('Usage: executable [OPTIONS]', self.trim('--help').stdout)
        p = self.trim('-d', 'merged')
        self.assertEqual(p.returncode, 2)
        self.assertIn('Invalid delete range format `merged`', p.stderr)
        self.assertEqual(self.trim('--bases').returncode, 2)
        self.assertEqual(self.trim('--update', '--no-update').returncode, 255)

    def test_base_and_no_remote(self):
        p = self.trim('--no-update', '--dry-run')
        self.assertEqual(p.returncode, 0)
        self.assertEqual(p.stdout, 'Branches that will remain:\n'
                         '  local branches:\n    main [base]\n'
                         '  remote references:\n    origin/main [base]\n\n')
        self.git('remote', 'remove', 'origin')
        p = self.trim('--no-update')
        self.assertEqual(p.returncode, 1)
        self.assertEqual(p.stderr, 'Error: git-trim requires at least one remote\n')

    def test_missing_default_base_explains_configuration(self):
        self.git('remote', 'set-head', 'origin', '--delete')
        p = self.trim('--no-update', '--dry-run')
        self.assertEqual(p.returncode, 1)
        self.assertIn('git remote set-head origin --auto', p.stderr)
        self.assertIn('No base branch is found!', p.stderr)
        self.assertEqual(self.trim('--no-update', '--dry-run', '-b', 'main').returncode, 0)

    def test_dry_run_preserves_both_sides(self):
        self.feature()
        before, before_remote = self.refs(), self.refs(self.remote)
        p = self.trim('--no-update', '--dry-run')
        self.assertEqual(p.returncode, 0)
        self.assertIn('Delete merged local branches:\n  - feature\n', p.stdout)
        self.assertIn('Delete merged remote refs:\n  - origin, refs/heads/feature\n', p.stdout)
        self.assertIn('Delete branch feature (dry run).', p.stdout)
        self.assertEqual(self.refs(), before)
        self.assertEqual(self.refs(self.remote), before_remote)

    def test_real_deletion_detaches_current_branch(self):
        self.feature()
        self.git('checkout', '-q', 'feature')
        oid = self.git('rev-parse', 'HEAD')
        p = self.trim('--no-update', '--no-confirm')
        self.assertEqual(p.returncode, 0, p.stderr)
        self.assertIn('Deleted branch feature', p.stdout)
        self.assertNotIn('refs/heads/feature', self.refs())
        self.assertNotIn('refs/heads/feature', self.refs(self.remote))
        self.assertEqual(self.git('rev-parse', 'HEAD'), oid)
        self.assertEqual(self.git('rev-parse', '--abbrev-ref', 'HEAD'), 'HEAD')

    def test_no_detach_keeps_current_branch_but_not_upstream(self):
        self.feature()
        self.git('checkout', '-q', 'feature')
        p = self.trim('--no-update', '--no-confirm', '--no-detach')
        self.assertEqual(p.returncode, 0)
        self.assertIn('feature [merged, but: HEAD]', p.stdout)
        self.assertIn('refs/heads/feature', self.refs())
        self.assertNotIn('refs/heads/feature', self.refs(self.remote))

    def test_confirmation_requires_a_terminal(self):
        self.feature()
        p = self.trim('--no-update')
        self.assertEqual(p.returncode, 1)
        self.assertEqual(p.stderr, 'Error: IO error: not a terminal\n\nCaused by:\n    not a terminal\n')
        self.assertIn('refs/heads/feature', self.refs())

    def test_protection_matches_local_and_remote_separately(self):
        self.feature()
        p = self.trim('--no-update', '--dry-run', '-p', 'feature')
        self.assertIn('feature [merged, but: protected by a pattern `feature`]', p.stdout)
        self.assertNotIn('Delete merged local branches:', p.stdout)
        self.assertIn('Delete merged remote refs:', p.stdout)
        p = self.trim('--no-update', '--dry-run', '-p', '*/feature')
        self.assertNotIn('Delete merged', p.stdout)

    def test_nontracking_and_nonupstream_ranges(self):
        self.git('branch', 'local')
        self.git('push', '-q', 'origin', 'local:remote-only')
        p = self.trim('--no-update', '--dry-run')
        self.assertIn('local *2', p.stdout)
        self.assertIn('origin/remote-only *3', p.stdout)
        p = self.trim('--no-update', '--dry-run', '-d', 'local,remote:origin')
        self.assertIn('  - local (non-tracking)', p.stdout)
        self.assertIn('  - origin, refs/heads/remote-only (non-upstream)', p.stdout)
        self.assertIn('main *1', p.stdout)

    def test_stray_unmerged_branch(self):
        self.git('checkout', '-qb', 'stray')
        self.commit_file('new', 'work not merged\n')
        self.git('push', '-qu', 'origin', 'stray')
        self.git('checkout', '-q', 'main')
        self.git('push', '-q', 'origin', '--delete', 'stray')
        p = self.trim('--no-update', '--dry-run')
        self.assertIn('stray [stray, but: delete range `stray` was not given]', p.stdout)
        p = self.trim('--no-update', '--dry-run', '-d', 'stray')
        self.assertIn('Delete stray local branches:\n  - stray\n', p.stdout)

    def test_diverged_upstream_is_opt_in(self):
        self.feature()
        self.git('checkout', '-q', 'feature')
        self.commit_file('later', 'upstream only\n')
        self.git('push', '-q')
        self.git('reset', '--hard', 'main')
        self.git('checkout', '-q', 'main')
        p = self.trim('--no-update', '--dry-run')
        self.assertIn('feature [diverged with refs/remotes/origin/feature', p.stdout)
        p = self.trim('--no-update', '--dry-run', '-d', 'diverged:origin')
        self.assertIn('Delete merged local branches:\n  - feature\n', p.stdout)
        self.assertIn('Delete diverged remote refs:\n  - origin, refs/heads/feature\n', p.stdout)

    def test_squash_equivalence(self):
        self.git('checkout', '-qb', 'topic')
        self.commit_file('one', 'first\n')
        self.commit_file('two', 'second\n')
        self.git('push', '-qu', 'origin', 'topic')
        self.git('checkout', '-q', 'main')
        self.git('merge', '--squash', 'topic')
        self.git('commit', '-qm', 'Squashed changes')
        self.git('push', '-q')
        p = self.trim('--no-update', '--dry-run')
        self.assertEqual(p.returncode, 0, p.stderr)
        self.assertIn('Delete merged local branches:\n  - topic\n', p.stdout)

    def test_config_and_explicit_override(self):
        self.feature()
        self.git('config', 'trim.protected', 'feature')
        self.git('config', 'trim.update', 'false')
        p = self.trim('--dry-run')
        self.assertTrue(p.stdout.startswith('Branches'))
        self.assertIn('protected by a pattern `feature`', p.stdout)
        p = self.trim('--dry-run', '-p', '')
        self.assertIn('Delete branch feature (dry run).', p.stdout)
        self.git('config', 'trim.bases', '')
        self.assertEqual(self.trim('--dry-run').returncode, 1)
        self.assertEqual(self.trim('--dry-run', '-b', 'main').returncode, 0)

    def test_other_worktree_is_protected(self):
        self.feature()
        path = self.root / 'other'
        self.git('worktree', 'add', '-q', str(path), 'feature')
        p = self.trim('--no-update', '--dry-run')
        self.assertIn('feature [merged, but: worktree at ' + str(path) + ']', p.stdout)
        self.assertNotIn('Delete branch feature (dry run).', p.stdout)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()

Building from source

  regression tests. They create isolated repositories with local remotes;

Implementation notes

interfaces. It checks both commit ancestry and equivalent rebased or squashed
changes before classifying branches. Planning is separate from mutation, with
base, pattern, worktree, and current-branch protections applied before the
requested Git operations are executed.
